name: Inline-Twin Engine Block
description: Simplified inline-twin engine block: two 86 mm cylinder bores, open-bottomed crankcase, three main-bearing saddles, head-stud and main-cap bolt holes.

steps.instruction: Create the block blank with the deck face at Z=220.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the engine block blank: a box 300 mm long (X, along the crank axis), 160 mm wide (Y) and 220 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0; the deck face is at Z=220.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the block blank — a 300 by 160 by 220 mm solid with the deck on top.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut the crankcase: remove an open-bottomed channel 120 mm wide (Y) from the bottom of the block up to Z=90, running the full 300 mm length so it is open at both ends.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the crankcase channel — the block is now an inverted U over the full length.

steps.instruction: Add three main-bearing bulkheads in the channel.

transcript.user_prompt: Add three main-bearing bulkheads inside the channel at X=-110, X=0 and X=110: each 20 mm thick (X), spanning the full 120 mm channel width, from Z=50 up to the channel ceiling at Z=90.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the three bulkheads hanging from the crankcase ceiling — they will carry the main bearings.

steps.instruction: Cut the crank tunnel, notching a saddle into each bulkhead.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut the crank tunnel: a 28 mm radius bore along the X axis at Y=0, Z=50, running the full length of the block — it notches a semicircular main-bearing saddle into the bottom of each bulkhead.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the crank tunnel — each bulkhead now has a 56 mm main-bearing saddle open to the crankcase.

steps.instruction: Cut two 86 mm cylinder bores through the deck.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut two cylinder bores of radius 43 mm (86 mm bore) centered at X=-55 and X=55, from the deck at Z=220 down through the channel ceiling at Z=90; the cylinder spacing is 110 mm.
transcript.assistant_message: I bored both 86 mm cylinders through the deck into the crankcase, 110 mm apart.

steps.instruction: Drill eight head-stud holes around the bores.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill eight 6 mm radius head-stud holes from the deck down to Z=79, breaking through the channel ceiling into the crankcase: at X offsets of +/-36 mm from each bore centre (X=-91, -19, 19 and 91) and Y=+/-52 mm.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the eight stud holes around the two bores, through the deck into the crankcase.

steps.instruction: Drill six blind main-cap bolt holes in the bulkheads.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill six blind main-cap bolt holes of radius 5 mm, 20 mm deep, upward into the underside of each bulkhead (from Z=50) at Y=40 and Y=-40 for each of the three bulkheads.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the six blind cap-bolt holes flanking the saddles — the block is complete.
